Features Convenience Package RVQG2500i LP Generator Girard Power Armless Awning w/ Motion Sensor & LED Lighting Rear Screen/Shade Truma D Furnace/Water Heater 12V Macerator Convection Microwave Fantastic Fan w/ Rain Sensor Induction Cooktop (24FL Dual Induction Cooktop) Solid Surface Counter Tops Showermiser 30 Amp Smart Plug Sumo Spring Suspension Kit Electronics Package 12V 24' Smart TV JBL Bluetooth Stereo MBUX 10.3' Infotainment 'Hey Mercedes' Voice Guidance Navigation Back up Camera Bluetooth Radio Apple CarPlay Victron 2000W Inverter Garmin Multiplex Control w/ Auto Gen Start Sure Level Holding Tank Monitors Get Away Wifi Extenders starlink Prep 330W Solar Package Truma Aventa 110V A/C with Soft Start Side Entry Screen Door Black Satin OE Wheel Works Rims Upgraded Alcoa Aluminum Wheels Cozy Wrap Upgraded Insulation Polar Package Plus Tank Heating System Sumo Springs Suspension AWD Modern Grey Wood More About This RV When the pavement ends, the adventure doesn't have to and that's exactly the point of the 2027 Coachmen Galleria 24RB AWD. Built on the award-winning Mercedes-Benz Sprinter chassis with all-wheel drive and a clean-running turbo-diesel engine, this luxury Class B pairs sure-footed traction in rain, snow, and gravel with the refined ride and fuel efficiency the Sprinter platform is famous for. The 24RB floorplan keeps things smart and simple: a private rear bath with an shower sits at the back so the rest of the coach stays open and usable, a center galley with generous counterspace and a convection microwave handles everything from morning coffee to camp dinners, and dual sofa beds up front convert the living area into comfortable sleeping quarters for two. Coachmen doesn't cut corners on the details you actually touch, custom hardwood cabinetry with soft-close doors and drawers and solid surface countertops. Mercedes driver-assist technology including a back-up camera, blind spot monitoring, and lane assist brings peace of mind to every mile, and the weatherproof 30-amp smart plug with LED power indicator makes arriving at camp effortless. Compact enough to park anywhere, capable enough to go almost anywhere, the Galleria 24RB AWD is the touring coach for couples who refuse to choose between comfort and capability.
